Semantic artefacts [1]
01

Semantic publishing [4, 5]
02
Semantic artefacts model scientific KGs.

Human-readable documentation
03
Supports comprehension by non-technical experts.
Several tools exist: WIDOCO [8], LODE [9], pyLODE [10]
Modular ontologies
04
Direct reuse via owl:imports, rdfs:isDefinedBy [11].
e.g. SKG-O, the Scientific Knowledge Graphs Interoperability Framework (SKG-IF) ontology, with its 6 modules [12]

SKG-O and current documentation
main SKG-O ontology
— owl:imports →
agent
data source
grant
research product
topic
venue
The SKG-O documentation is currently published in WIDOCO. Its entities are defined across the modules, about 180 in total: the main ontology does not define any, it is just a collector.
Modules redefine the same entities. For instance, foaf:homepage is annotated in both the agent and the grant module, each with its own description.
<https://w3id.org/skg-if/ontology/agent/> { foaf:homepage a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "foaf:homepage (SKG-IF labels: website)" ; dc:description """… (domain): * foaf:Organization … (range): * foaf:Document""" ; rdfs:isDefinedBy foaf: . }
<https://w3id.org/skg-if/ontology/grant/> { foaf:homepage a owl:ObjectProperty ; rdfs:label "foaf:homepage (SKG-IF labels: website)" ; dc:description """… (domain): * frapo:Grant … (range): * foaf:Document""" ; rdfs:isDefinedBy foaf: . }
